title: Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this surgical instruments application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by laparoscopic stapler anvil plate and fat life requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for surgical instruments geometry
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil suitable for Laparoscopic stapler anvil plate?
faq.a: Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address surgical instruments operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. surgical instruments components receive Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Laparoscopic Stapler Anvil shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.
